lead_raw_text:
The structure of Yb2AgHg crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with a unit cell containing eight atoms—four Yb, two Ag, and two Hg—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows each Ag and Hg center coordinated by eight Yb neighbors, while each Yb center has four Ag and four Hg neighbors, with all neighbor distances near 3.19–3.20 Å. The resulting geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Yb-centered 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ag- and Hg-centered polyhedra.
